name: dmidecode
description: Decodes the DMI/SMBIOS tables: exact motherboard model, serial numbers, BIOS version, and memory module details. Requires root.

flags.description: -t bios, -t system, -t baseboard, -t processor: specific tables.

examples.explanation: Exact server model without opening the chassis.
Per-module RAM size and speed — how you verify what RAM is installed in which slot.
BIOS/firmware version — needed before firmware updates.

about: dmidecode reads the firmware-provided SMBIOS tables from /dev/mem or /sys/firmware/dmi. Values are reported by the vendor and can be wrong or empty on cheap hardware and some VMs. It is read-only and safe — it never changes hardware settings.
mistakes: Running without sudo — it requires root.
Trusting serial numbers on VMs — hypervisors often inject generic values.
